units.locator: Article 21.4. Failure to provide information necessary for maintaining military registration records
units.text: Failure or delay by officials of state bodies or organizations in providing information necessary for maintaining military registration records in the manner established by federal law —
units.label: Art. 21.4 · “Failure or delay by officials of state bodies or organizations…”

units.locator: Article 21.4. Failure to provide information necessary for maintaining military registration records
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles.
units.label: Art. 21.4 · “shall entail an administrative fine for officials of forty…”

units.locator: Article 21.5. Failure by citizens to fulfil military registration duties
units.text: Article 21.5. Failure by citizens to fulfil military registration duties
units.label: Art. 21.5

units.locator: Article 21.5. Failure by citizens to fulfil military registration duties
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 21.5. Failure by citizens to fulfil military registration duties
units.label: Art. 21.5

units.locator: Article 21.5. Failure by citizens to fulfil military registration duties
units.text: 1. Failure by a citizen, without a valid reason, to appear at the time and place specified in a military commissariat’s summons or in response to a call from another body responsible for military registration —
units.label: Part 1 Art. 21.5

units.locator: Article 21.5. Failure by citizens to fulfil military registration duties
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine of ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 21.5 · “shall entail an administrative fine of ten thousand to thirty…”

units.locator: Article 21.5. Failure by citizens to fulfil military registration duties
units.text: 2. Failure by a citizen to notify a military commissariat or a body responsible for primary military registration, in the manner established by federal law, of a change in marital status, education, place of work (study) or position —
units.label: Part 2 Art. 21.5

units.locator: Article 21.5. Failure by citizens to fulfil military registration duties
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand to five thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 21.5 · “shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand to five…”

units.locator: Article 21.5. Failure by citizens to fulfil military registration duties
units.text: 2.1. Failure by a citizen to notify a military commissariat or a body responsible for primary military registration, in the manner established by federal law, of moving to a new place of stay not confirmed by registration, or failure to appear at a military commissariat within the period established by federal law when moving to a new place of stay not confirmed by registration —
units.label: Part 2.1 Art. 21.5

units.locator: Article 21.5. Failure by citizens to fulfil military registration duties
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 2.1 Art. 21.5 · “shall entail an administrative fine of ten thousand to twenty…”

units.locator: Article 21.5. Failure by citizens to fulfil military registration duties
units.text: 3. Failure by a citizen to notify a military commissariat or a body responsible for primary military registration, in the manner established by federal law, of departure from the Russian Federation for more than six months or entry into the Russian Federation, or failure to appear at a military commissariat within the period established by federal law when those events occur —
units.label: Part 3 Art. 21.5

units.locator: Article 21.5. Failure by citizens to fulfil military registration duties
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five thousand to fifteen thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 21.5 · “shall entail an administrative fine of five thousand to fifteen…”

units.locator: Article 21.5. Failure by citizens to fulfil military registration duties
units.text: 4. Failure by a citizen subject to conscription for military service to notify a military commissariat or a body responsible for primary military registration, in the manner established by federal law, of departure for more than three months from their place of residence or place of stay, including where those places are not confirmed by registration at the place of residence and/or place of stay —
units.label: Part 4 Art. 21.5

units.locator: Article 21.5. Failure by citizens to fulfil military registration duties
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 21.5 · “shall entail an administrative fine of ten thousand to twenty…”

units.locator: Article 21.6. Evasion of medical examination
units.text: Evasion by a citizen of a medical fitness assessment or medical examination upon referral by a commission for citizens’ military registration, or of a medical examination upon referral by a conscription commission —
units.label: Art. 21.6 · “Evasion by a citizen of a medical fitness assessment or medical…”

units.locator: Article 21.6. Evasion of medical examination
units.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine of fifteen thousand to twenty-five thousand roubles.
units.label: Art. 21.6 · “shall entail a warning or an administrative fine of fifteen…”

units.locator: Article 21.7. Intentional damage to or loss of military registration documents
units.text: Intentional damage to or destruction of a certificate of a citizen subject to conscription for military service, a military identity document (a temporary certificate issued in its place), a certificate in lieu of a military identity document or a personal electronic card, or negligent safekeeping of a certificate of a citizen subject to conscription for military service, a military identity document (a temporary certificate issued in its place), a certificate in lieu of a military identity document or a personal electronic card resulting in their loss —
units.label: Art. 21.7 · “Intentional damage to or destruction of a certificate of a…”

units.locator: Article 21.7. Intentional damage to or loss of military registration documents
units.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine of three thousand to five thousand roubles.
units.label: Art. 21.7 · “shall entail a warning or an administrative fine of three…”

units.locator: Article 22.1. Judges and bodies authorized to consider administrative offence cases
units.text: Article 22.1. Judges and bodies authorized to consider administrative offence cases
units.label: Art. 22.1

units.locator: Article 22.1. Judges and bodies authorized to consider administrative offence cases
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 22.1. Judges and bodies authorized to consider administrative offence cases
units.label: Art. 22.1

units.locator: Article 22.1. Judges and bodies authorized to consider administrative offence cases
units.text: 1. Cases concerning administrative offences provided for by this Code are considered, within the competence established by Chapter 23 of this Code, by:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 22.1

units.locator: Article 22.1. Judges and bodies authorized to consider administrative offence cases
units.text: 1) judges (justices of the peace);
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 22.1

units.locator: Article 22.1. Judges and bodies authorized to consider administrative offence cases
units.text: 2) commissions for minors’ affairs and the protection of their rights;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 22.1

units.locator: Article 22.1. Judges and bodies authorized to consider administrative offence cases
units.text: 3) federal executive bodies, their structural divisions, territorial bodies and the structural divisions of territorial bodies, and other state bodies in accordance with the tasks and functions assigned to them by federal laws or normative legal acts of the President of the Russian Federation or the Government of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 22.1

units.locator: Article 22.1. Judges and bodies authorized to consider administrative offence cases
units.text: 3.1) the Bank of Russia in accordance with the tasks and functions assigned to it by federal laws;
units.label: Point 3.1 Part 1 Art. 22.1

units.locator: Article 22.1. Judges and bodies authorized to consider administrative offence cases
units.text: 4) bodies and institutions of the penal enforcement system;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 22.1

units.locator: Article 22.1. Judges and bodies authorized to consider administrative offence cases
units.text: 5) repealed. — Federal Law of 14.10.2014 No. 307-ФЗ;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 22.1

units.locator: Article 22.1. Judges and bodies authorized to consider administrative offence cases
units.text: 6) executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising regional state supervision or transferred powers of federal state supervision, and financial bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation providing treasury support, as specified in Chapter 23 of this Code;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 22.1

units.locator: Article 22.1. Judges and bodies authorized to consider administrative offence cases
units.text: 7) state institutions subordinate to federal executive bodies authorized under federal laws to exercise federal state forest supervision (forest protection), federal state fire supervision, state port control or state supervision over the use and protection of specially protected natural areas of federal significance; state institutions subordinate to executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation authorized under federal laws to exercise federal state forest supervision (forest protection) or state supervision over the use and protection of specially protected natural areas of regional significance; and state institutions subordinate to executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation authorized to exercise regional state control (supervision) in the tourism industry (where the exercise of regional state control (supervision) in the tourism industry is assigned to such state institutions).
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 22.1

units.locator: Article 22.1. Judges and bodies authorized to consider administrative offence cases
units.text: 2. Cases concerning administrative offences provided for by laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation are considered, within the powers established by those laws, by:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 22.1

units.locator: Article 22.1. Judges and bodies authorized to consider administrative offence cases
units.text: 1) justices of the peace;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 22.1

units.locator: Article 22.1. Judges and bodies authorized to consider administrative offence cases
units.text: 2) commissions for minors’ affairs and the protection of their rights;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 22.1

units.locator: Article 22.1. Judges and bodies authorized to consider administrative offence cases
units.text: 3) authorized bodies and institutions of executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 22.1

units.locator: Article 22.1. Judges and bodies authorized to consider administrative offence cases
units.text: 4) administrative commissions and other collegial bodies established in accordance with laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation or normative legal acts of the public authorities of a federal territory;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 22.1

units.locator: Article 22.1. Judges and bodies authorized to consider administrative offence cases
units.text: 5) state institutions subordinate to the respective executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation authorized under federal laws to exercise federal state forest supervision (forest protection) or state supervision over the use and protection of specially protected natural areas in specially protected natural areas of regional significance.
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 22.1

units.locator: Article 22.2. Powers of officials
units.text: Article 22.2. Powers of officials
units.label: Art. 22.2

units.locator: Article 22.2. Powers of officials
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 22.2. Powers of officials
units.label: Art. 22.2

units.locator: Article 22.2. Powers of officials
units.text: 1. Cases concerning administrative offences provided for by this Code are considered by the officials specified in Chapter 23 of this Code within their powers.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 22.2

units.locator: Article 22.2. Powers of officials
units.text: 2. The following may consider administrative offence cases on behalf of the bodies specified in point 3 of part 1 of Article 22.1 of this Code:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 22.2

units.locator: Article 22.2. Powers of officials
units.text: 1) heads of federal executive bodies and their deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 22.2

units.locator: Article 22.2. Powers of officials
units.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of federal executive bodies and their deputies;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 22.2

units.locator: Article 22.2. Powers of officials
units.text: 3) heads of territorial bodies of federal executive bodies and their deputies;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 22.2

units.locator: Article 22.2. Powers of officials
units.text: 4) heads of structural divisions of territorial bodies of federal executive bodies and their deputies;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 22.2

units.locator: Article 22.2. Powers of officials
units.text: 5) other officials exercising supervisory or control functions under federal laws or normative legal acts of the President of the Russian Federation or the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 22.2

units.locator: Article 22.2. Powers of officials
units.text: 3. Heads of arrest houses, correctional institutions, pretrial detention centres and temporary detention facilities may consider administrative offence cases on behalf of the bodies specified in point 4 of part 1 of Article 22.1 of this Code.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 22.2

units.locator: Article 22.2. Powers of officials
units.text: 4. Repealed. — Federal Law of 14.10.2014 No. 307-ФЗ.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 22.2

units.locator: Article 22.2. Powers of officials
units.text: 5. The following may consider administrative offence cases on behalf of the bodies specified in point 6 of part 1 of Article 22.1 of this Code:
units.label: Part 5 Art. 22.2

units.locator: Article 22.2. Powers of officials
units.text: 1) heads of executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and their deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 5 Art. 22.2

units.locator: Article 22.2. Powers of officials
units.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of those executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and their deputies;
units.label: Point 2 Part 5 Art. 22.2

units.locator: Article 22.2. Powers of officials
units.text: 3) other officials specified in Chapter 23 of this Code who are state inspectors of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and are authorized to exercise federal state supervision (control).
units.label: Point 3 Part 5 Art. 22.2

units.locator: Article 22.2. Powers of officials
units.text: 5.1. Heads of state institutions and their deputies may consider administrative offence cases on behalf of the institutions specified in point 7 of part 1 of Article 22.1 of this Code. Other officials who are state fire supervision inspectors may also consider administrative offence cases on behalf of state institutions that are subordinate to the federal executive body authorized to perform fire safety tasks and that are themselves authorized to exercise federal state fire supervision.
units.label: Part 5.1 Art. 22.2
